learning_outcomes.text: Familiarization with the terminology of the field and recognition of the functional-constructive necessities for tools, devices, and gauges used in mechanical manufacturing.
Appropriate selection of tools, devices, and gauges in the manufacturing preparation activity depending on the type of processing required by the size-type and material of the part.

syllabus_topics: Force, mechanical work, and power required for machining on m-u.
Functional role, classification, and place of devices in manufacturing
Positioning, functional, dimensioning, and processing bases
Form and dimensional control using gauges
Selection and measurement of geometric parameters of cutting tools
Machining with milling and gear cutting tools
Calculation of positioning and centering errors
Verification of form and dimensions with templates and gauges

assessment_methods.method: Oral examination based on individual ticket with two distinct subjects
Testing and verification of practical knowledge and conclusions in the laboratory notebook

assessment_rules: A minimum grade of 5 is achieved by scoring 50% correct answers on each of the two subjects on the exam ticket and achieving a minimum grade of 5 for ongoing activity.
